name: Cascade Canyon via Jenny Lake and Inspiration Point
why: Across Jenny Lake by boat, up past Hidden Falls to Inspiration Point, and into a canyon of meadows and moose between the Grand Teton and Mount Owen.
book: No permit. The Jenny Lake shuttle boat (fee) saves 3 km each way; without it walk round the lake on the Jenny Lake Trail.
water: Cascade Creek all along the canyon; filter.
dangers: Black and grizzly bears and moose in the canyon: bear spray.
Inspiration Point is crowded and the rock ledge is unfenced.
turnaround: Turn at the Forks of Cascade Canyon.

points.name: Jenny Lake west boat dock
points.note: Where the shuttle boat lands under the Tetons.

points.name: Hidden Falls
points.note: A 30 m cascade in the forest.

points.name: Inspiration Point
points.note: A rock ledge 120 m above Jenny Lake with the valley of Jackson Hole beyond.

points.name: Forks of Cascade Canyon
points.note: Where the canyon splits toward Lake Solitude and Hurricane Pass.
